LESSON: NEIGHBOURHOOD ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.5: Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the classmates by names for harmonious living friendship
2. name the classmates as neighbours for interpersonal relationships 129
3. identify physical features in the neighbourhood for safety and security
4. appreciate the classmates as their neighbours mountains etc. Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the classmates by names for harmonious living friendship
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the classmates by names for harmonious living friendship. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. name the classmates as neighbours for interpersonal relationships 129
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the classmates as neighbours for interpersonal relationships 129. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. identify physical features in the neighbourhood for safety and security
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify physical features in the neighbourhood for safety and security. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the classmates as their neighbours mountains etc. Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the classmates as their neighbours mountains etc. Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: identify the classmates by names for harmonious living friendship
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the classmates by names for harmonious living friendship
2. name the classmates as neighbours for interpersonal relationships 129
3. identify physical features in the neighbourhood for safety and security
4. appreciate the classmates as their neighbours mountains etc. Core-Competences to be developed:

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
